title: Affine formal modules: objectwise reconstruction
statement: Objectwise affine reconstruction isomorphisms under the surjective projection and kernel hypotheses.

proof.text: The affine first-isomorphism and tilde/Gamma argument described in Lemma 087W proves the stated reconstruction component (and, for assembly, its compatibility equations).

mathlib_searches.query: natural isomorphism assembled from objectwise isomorphisms

lean.statement: theorem coherentFormalModules_affine_reconstruction_objectwise (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) (J : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).IdealSheafData) (hJ : J = Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)) (L : CoherentFormalModule (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) J ⥤ ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (fun N : ModuleCat.{u} (AdicCompletion I A) ↦ Module.Finite (AdicCompletion I A) N)) (p : ∀ F : CoherentFormalModule (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) J, (Functor.const ℕᵒᵖ).obj ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion I A))).obj (L.obj F).obj) ⟶ F.obj ⋙ moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of A)) (hquotient : (∀ (F : CoherentFormalModule (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) J) (n : ℕ), Function.Surjective ((p F).app (op n)) ∧ LinearMap.ker ((p F).app (op n)).hom = I ^ (n + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule A ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion I A))).obj (L.obj F).obj)))) : ∀ F, Nonempty ((L ⋙ coherentFormalModules_affine_quotientFunctor A I J hJ).obj F ≅ F)
